geeklist.title: Auction w/ PnP Freebies
geeklist.description:
Auction with some print & play freebies! I do a little bit of print & play when I get some time and am unloading some of them after playing with them a few times. PnP Freebies can be claimed if you win/BIN worth $50.
[size=18][b][COLOR=#CC0000]Auction Details:[/COLOR] [/b][/size] [b]Ships from:[/b] 94086, CA [b]Ends:[/b] [COLOR=#CC0000][b]30th January, 2026[/b][/COLOR] at around 8pm PST All sales go through BGG so that they get their 3% commission.
[size=18][b][COLOR=#CC0000]Rules of the Auction:[/COLOR] [/b][/size] 0. [b]Free Game[/b] with a total winning bid value of $50 or more (You can claim any one of the available BIN games if your total winning bids or BINs are at least $50) These are mostly PnP games (very tastefully PnP-ed, if I may!) 1. Bids in whole number increments. 2. Local pickup is preferred. [i][b]DM me if you are local and want to buy a bundle![/b][/i] 3. [b]Starting bids are my reserve values.[/b] This way it is easier for me as any bid placed would result a sale. 4. I reserve the right to remove any game from the auction at any time (odds are pretty low though, as it could affect people's freebie claims).
[b]How to pay? [/b]- Paypal/Venmo/Zelle
